chunks: You will find the Jews and idolaters most excessive in hatred of those who believe; and the closest in love to the faithful are the people who say: "We are the followers of Christ," because there are priests and monks among them, and they are not arrogant.

key_terms.وَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ: And that they are not arrogant

ai.seo_question: Why are Christians considered closest in love to Muslims according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing the general disposition of these communities during the Prophet's time, noting that the 'priests and monks' (Qissisun wa Ruhban) refer to those who remained relatively humble and receptive to Islam, unlike the Jewish tribes who were more entrenched in tribal arrogance. The phrase 'they do not arrogate themselves' (la yastakbirun) highlights their spiritual modesty, which facilitated their closer affinity to the believers, though this is understood as a historical tendency rather than an absolute eternal rule for all Christians.
